Integration Code

<!-- 1. Add target div where you want the form -->
<div id="upsale-form-YOUR_FORM_ID"></div>

<!-- 2. Load embed script before </body> -->
<script src="http://localhost:3001/forms/embed.js"></script>
<script>
  upsaleForms('init', {
    apiUrl: 'http://localhost:3001/v1',
    formId: 'YOUR_FORM_ID'
  });
</script>
